measured: Twenty at 1d561b8c73c984058a5121ec229f4805a2424a91 ships Mistral in its built-in model picker. LibreChat custom endpoint configuration and OCR strategy remain optional.

optional.setting: Configuration (1): the operator adds endpoints.custom with baseURL=https://api.mistral.ai/v1 and MISTRAL_API_KEY; absent custom config returns no custom models (packages/api/src/app/loader.ts:174,215-222; packages/api/src/endpoints/config/models.ts:59-61,80-82).
optional.client: axios for models and OCR; @librechat/agents@4.0.1 src/llm/openai/index.ts:2164 for custom endpoint streaming (packages/api/src/endpoints/openai/llm.ts:598,644; api/server/controllers/agents/openai.js:1094,1135). No official Mistral SDK.

calls.call: configured custom endpoint streamed conversation and title

optional.setting: Configuration (1): the operator supplies ocr.strategy=mistral_ocr and OCR_API_KEY; absent appConfig.ocr selects the document parser (api/server/services/Files/process.js:1018,1031).
optional.client: axios for models and OCR; @librechat/agents@4.0.1 src/llm/openai/index.ts:2164 for custom endpoint streaming (packages/api/src/endpoints/openai/llm.ts:598,644; api/server/controllers/agents/openai.js:1094,1135). No official Mistral SDK.

calls.call: document_url or image_url OCR, image_limit=0 and include_image_base64=false
delete the temporary upload after OCR or on failure

standIns: Console application credentials and completion IDs are World bookkeeping; model turns are scripted or labeled deterministic stubs.
notDemanded: All other spec operations, including model discovery, files, OCR and agents, remain outside the demanded calls.

applications.evidence: packages/twenty-server/src/engine/metadata-modules/ai/ai-models/services/provider-config.service.ts:28 merges the shipped catalog; ai-providers.json:1966 ships Mistral. Credentials enable access, not an optional installation.
applications.gate: The built-in catalog contains OpenAI, Google, Anthropic, xAI and Mistral; default tiers try them in that order according to available credentials, with no disabled models. This is automatic credential resolution, not an operator provider switch (packages/twenty-server/src/engine/metadata-modules/ai/ai-models/services/default-ai-catalog.service.ts:19-37; services/provider-config.service.ts:28-41; utils/load-default-model-preferences.util.ts:14-19,58).
